rationale: The extended-window fact was supplemented this run with a second execution, and its statement still reads as one execution's numbers: it says the confirmation returns nil again at 5509ms and that the control returns leadership loss at 20003ms, which are the latencies of the first receipt only, while the second execution returned the second confirmation at 4928ms and its control at 20007ms and a third repeat returned 5398ms and 20002ms. I am correcting the statement of that entry under its own id so its content matches the receipts it cites, without changing what it is a fact about: in this configuration the second confirmation arrives several seconds after the partition while a competing leader already leads, and the control's error arrives when the lease expires. No recorded use depends on the exact milliseconds (the entry has no recorded uses, and the interpretations cite the indices rather than the latencies), so the correction is confined to the entry's own statement.

knowledge.statement: With voters {L, far1, far2} and non-voter C, per-node timing (L: HeartbeatTimeout=ElectionTimeout=LeaderLeaseTimeout=20s; far1, far2: 3s; C: 6s) and the partition {L, C} | {far1, far2}: L answers VerifyLeader with nil immediately after the partition, and answers nil again several seconds later (4928ms, 5398ms and 5509ms in the executions recorded) at a moment when one of the far nodes is already Leader while L is still Leader, with that far node having committed a write at index 5 that L's FSM lacks (L at applied index 3). With the same per-node timing but C still a voter (four voters, quorum 3) no competitor can appear and the same call returns "leadership lost while committing log" when L's 20s lease expires (20002ms, 20003ms and 20007ms in the executions recorded).
knowledge.conditions: Real 4-node in-memory cluster, only L bootstrapped; near node demoted voter->non-voter through the public DemoteVoter API; transport routes between {L, C} and {far1, far2} removed in both directions; CommitTimeout 200ms; leader lease 20s.
knowledge.changed_premise: The statement previously presented the latencies of a single execution (5509ms and 20003ms) as the fact's content while the entry cites three executions whose latencies differ; it now reports the observed range across those executions and keeps the same subject, conditions and sources.
